# secureaccess_identities (Data Source)

This is Early Access and may be subject to changes. This resource reads Identities of a single identity type.
 If `items` is empty, all Identities of `identity_type` are returned, otherwise only the listed ones.
 If `search` is provided, only Identities matching the search string are returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_identities" "example" {
  identity_type = "directory_group"
  items = {
    "Finance" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity_type` (String) Identity type to read.
  - Choices: `ad_connector`, `android`, `anyconnect`, `app_connector_agent`, `bdr`, `branch`, `chromebook_user`, `connected_devices`, `device`, `directory_computer`, `directory_domain`, `directory_group`, `directory_user`, `domain_controller`, `edlp_client`, `gsuite_domain`, `gsuite_group`, `gsuite_user`, `internal_network`, `meraki_auto_vpn`, `mobile_device`, `network`, `network_device`, `network_dns_forwarder`, `network_tunnel_hub`, `on_network`, `policy`, `roaming`, `saml_group`, `saml_user`, `secure_web_appliance`, `sgt_id`, `site`, `tunnel_device`, `vpn`, `vpn_id`, `ztna_client`

### Optional

- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Specifies whether to include deleted identities, i.e. marked as deleted or with `(deleted)` in the name.
  - Default value: `false`
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of Identities. The key of the map is the name of the individual Identity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `search` (String) Search string, only Identities where it appears in the Identity data are returned.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `deleted` (Boolean) Deletion status of the Identity.
- `id` (Number) Id of the Identity.
- `type_id` (Number) Type ID of the Identity.
